summary: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 20:45 - Diagnosed and fixed the broken preview storage/playback pipeline. Root cause: commit 82e4169 (06 Jun 2026) reverted the preview transport from Array.from(bytes) back to raw Uint8Array over browser.runtime.sendMessage. Runtime messages are JSON-serialized, so a Uint8Array arrives as a numeric-key object and new Uint8Array(obj) rebuilds as 0 bytes - corrupting BOTH preview.save (stored 0-byte records) and preview.get (returned 0-byte blobs). PreviewThumb then silently bailed on blob.size<100, so no preview ever rendered. Fix: base64 transport (blobB64) in vault-client savePreview/getPreview and the background preview.save/preview.get handlers, matching the existing base64 codec used for VaultMaterial. Also: background refuses to store empty payloads; runCapturePipeline no longer clears data.thumbnail before the preview is durably persisted and now falls through to regeneration when the write fails; PreviewThumb treats undersized blobs as a cache miss so retry/regeneration runs. Added src/lib/preview-transport.test.ts (6 tests) covering the wire boundary and round trip. Verified: vitest 13/13 pass, esbuild bundles background+processor clean, vite build clean. NOTE pre-existing blocker: npm run build fails at tsc because the vaultwares-themes submodule ships crypto-vault.js only (no .ts), so vault-runtime.ts type imports do not resolve. dist/ NOT rebuilt - fix is not live in the packaged extension until that is resolved.
